text_block_list.text:
Even after the Classic year came to an 
end, Fuji Kiseki's skyrocketing popularity 
showed no signs of slowing down.

Race highlight clips started surpassing 
hundreds of thousands of views, and 
articles were being published almost 
daily—

Eventually, the term '#FujiWithdrawal' was 
born, and everyone eagerly awaited her 
next big performance... Then, one day.

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um... excuse me. Do you have a moment 
right now?

The junior Umamusume who had previously 
poured out her worries to Fuji Kiseki came 
over.

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I've been watching your races. Always.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I knew. Ever since then, you were 
always there in the stands.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I was so happy! Knowing that you're trying 
to move forward.

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No, not really. At first, it was more like 
I just went to watch out of sheer 
desperation...

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“Still... watching you fight so head-on 
made me realize how pathetic I was being.”

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I was just sulking. Lamenting my 
aptitudes, wondering why it always had to 
be me. But that wasn't it at all."

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I just hadn't made up my mind. 
I lacked the resolve to choose my own 
future.

She said, wearing a somewhat refreshed 
smile.

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I've decided on the path I must take. It's 
thanks to you that I was able to change, 
Fuji-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see, I'm glad! That's the highest praise 
I could ask for!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I was hoping I could pave the way for you 
all. That wish was the driving force 
behind everything."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So, in other words—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I sincerely pray for your future 
happiness. ...May your future be filled 
with smiles.

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes!

Fuji Kiseki waves with a smile to her 
departing junior. Though her dazed look 
from earlier lingered in the back of my 
mind—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well now, Trainer. There's something I 
want to talk to you about!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright if we moved to the 
trainer's office for a bit?

Fuji Kiseki's expression as she looked at 
me was as bright as ever.

Swallowing back my unease, I headed for 
the Trainer's Office to hear her out.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—We talked about it before, remember? 
About what I need to accomplish in my 
Senior year.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"For everyone who has been eagerly waiting 
for me, I want to deliver entertainment 
that goes far beyond what I showed in the 
Classic year!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want to make the impossible possible, 
and create a true miracle...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And as for what we'll be doing there—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Whether it's that pony-chan earlier or 
me, as long as we're Umamusume, there are 
things that inevitably tie us down, aren't 
there?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because it's an inescapable 
constraint, I'll challenge it even more 
fiercely than during the Classic year! And 
shatter that wall to pieces—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think it would be wonderful if 
we could put on a show like that?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll conquer GⅠ races across four 
different distances!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
First, the 1200m sprint, the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen. Next, running the 
1600m mile, the Yasuda Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In autumn, we have the 2,000m 
middle-distance Tenno Sho (Autumn). And 
the finale is the 2,500m long-distance 
Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In every single one of these races, I 
shall prevail in thrilling, white-knuckle 
battles and claim victory!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone will surely think, "That's 
reckless!" "What are you talking 
about?!"...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why... there's no way I 
could turn down such a mouth-watering 
challenge. Wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
How about it? I'd be glad if you agreed 
with me.

"...Seeing her so extraordinarily fired 
up, I couldn't bring myself to object. 
Above all—"
choice_data_list: I really feel like you can see it through.
I really feel like you can pull it off.

text_block_list.text:
Her success in the Classic Year turned 
into entertainment that thrilled just as 
many people as she had aimed for—no, even 
more.

If it's Fuji Kiseki, she might just pull 
it off. No matter how reckless the 
challenge might be.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-san! I knew I could 
count on you to say that.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's decided, no time to 
dilly-dally. Let the show begin at once!

The next day, Fuji Kiseki's Senior Year 
rotation and goals were extensively 
covered by the media.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, look! It says 'Fuji Kiseki's 
Challenge Special'!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Expert
text_block_list.text:
"To explain from the perspective of 
aptitudes just how difficult it is to win 
four races across different distance 
categories—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Expert
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O... she is your textbook 
sprinter, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Expert
text_block_list.text:
At distances up to 1,400 meters, she 
displays overwhelming strength.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Expert
text_block_list.text: Next up is Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Expert
text_block_list.text:
All the graded races she's won have been 
2500m or longer. You could truly call her 
a born stayer.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Expert
text_block_list.text: Then, what determines one's best distance?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Expert
text_block_list.text:
"This is the same for both humans and 
Umamusume; it varies based on innate 
traits and the ratio of slow-twitch to 
fast-twitch muscle fibers."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Expert
text_block_list.text:
The higher the ratio of fast-twitch muscle 
fibers—which contract quickly and fatigue 
easily—the better suited an athlete is as 
a sprinter requiring explosive bursts of 
speed—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Expert
text_block_list.text:
Conversely, while their contraction speed 
is slow, they are resistant to fatigue—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, so it's a matter of inherent 
qualities.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
If even hard work can't fix it, then it 
must be really tough~

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"Still, look at it the other way—if you 
pull this off, it'll be amazing! Like 
overcoming what you were born with!"

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Right? Unifying the nation starting as a 
humble farmer, or being the ace attacker 
despite being short— there's a real 
coolness to that kind of thing, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...All right! I have to do my best...!

Expectations for the Senior Class only 
continued to soar.
